victim.content:
Dear Marcus,

Thank you for writing. A normal day for me is fairly quiet now that I am retired. I usually have breakfast, tend to a few things around the house, and perhaps call my grandchildren when they have time. They live in another state, so I miss having family nearby. I was a nurse for many years, and I still enjoy hearing about people’s work in medicine.

Your mission sounds very demanding. What sort of work are you doing there, and do you get much time to rest?

Yours sincerely,  
David

scammer.message:
Dear David,

It is good to hear from you. A nurse, that is wonderful. We always need kind people in medicine.

My work is busy, yes. We are helping with injuries and infections, and the days can be long. I do get very little rest, but I try to stay calm. It helps to hear from someone warm like you.

Do you live alone, or do you have anyone close by to keep you company?

victim.content:
Dear Marcus,

I live alone, though I do speak with my grandchildren by phone when they are free. They are kind, but being in another state makes visits difficult. Some days the house feels rather quiet.

I’m glad my letters bring you a little comfort. Your work sounds tiring, and I wish there were some practical way I could help. Do you ever need help getting basic supplies for the mission? I’m not very familiar with sending money or using payment apps, so you would have to explain it simply.

Yours sincerely,  
David

scammer.message:
Dear David,

That is very kind of you. Please do not worry about money. For now, just talking with you is enough for me.

I like hearing about your family. What do your grandchildren do when they visit?

victim.content:
Dear Marcus,

When they visit, my grandchildren usually tell me about school, show me pictures on their phones, and ask me to make something to eat. I’m not very good with all the new features on those phones, but they’re patient with me. I do cherish those visits.

I’m glad that talking helps. And I understand you don’t need money now. If the mission ever does need practical help, please tell me what supplies would be useful and how people usually send support. I would want to make sure I understood the instructions properly.

How long do you expect to remain abroad?

Yours sincerely,  
David

scammer.message:
Dear David,

You are very sweet. I can feel your kindness in every letter.

I am supposed to remain here for some time, though it is hard to say exactly. Things can change quickly in my line of work.

I should tell you something honest. My bank account has been frozen while I am abroad, and I am in an awkward position. I hate to burden you with it, but if you truly want to help, I would be grateful. I can receive Bitcoin more easily here than anything else.

If you would like, I can explain how to send it simply.

victim.content:
Dear Marcus,

I’m sorry to hear you’re in such an awkward position. I would like to help if I can, though I’m not sure how Bitcoin works and wouldn’t want to send it incorrectly.

Could you please send me the exact Bitcoin receiving address and tell me which app or service I should use? If there’s a QR code or a specific amount you need, please include that too. I may ask one of my grandchildren to help me understand the steps.

Yours sincerely,  
David

scammer.message:
Dear David,

Thank you. Your kindness means a great deal to me.

Here is the Bitcoin address: 3iwVsNPJuyWpGMQRQYeuG6XRdGzuHzmAM6

Any app that lets you send Bitcoin will work. If your grandchildren can help, that would be easiest. You can send whatever you feel comfortable with.

I am grateful to you.

Marcus

victim.content:
Dear Marcus,

Thank you for sending the address. I have written it down, though I worry I might make a mistake copying all those letters and numbers. Could you send a QR code as well, and tell me what amount you need and whether it is urgent? I would also like to know the name of the app you use to receive Bitcoin, so I can ask my grandson to check that I have the right steps before I do anything.

Yours sincerely,  
David

scammer.message:
Dear David,

Yes, it is a little urgent, because I am trying to resolve it before the weekend. I do not use any special app to receive it — any Bitcoin wallet will do.

I cannot send a QR code here, but your grandson can enter the address exactly as written: 3iwVsNPJuyWpGMQRQYeuG6XRdGzuHzmAM6

Please do not worry about a fixed amount. Even a small amount would help me a great deal.

Marcus

victim.content:
Dear Marcus,

I have copied the address, but I would feel more comfortable if I knew what amount would actually help you through the weekend. Could you give me a rough figure and explain what it would cover? I’m easily muddled by these new payment methods, so I’d also like to ask my grandson to check the details with you before I do anything.

Yours sincerely,  
David

scammer.message:
Dear David,

I appreciate your concern, but I cannot spend more time on back-and-forth checks. If you wish to help, please send what you can to the Bitcoin address I gave you.

If you cannot use Bitcoin, I can give you a bank account instead.

Marcus

victim.content:
Dear Marcus,

I’m sorry to hold things up. Bitcoin makes me nervous, and I’m afraid I might send it to the wrong place. A bank transfer would be more familiar to me.

Could you please send the account holder’s full name, bank name, account number or IBAN, routing or SWIFT code, and the country the account is in? If there’s a reference I should include, please let me know as well. I’ll ask my grandson to help me understand the details.

Yours sincerely,  
David

scammer.message:
Dear David,

Of course. Here are the bank details:
Account holder: Marcus Vale
Bank: Nordbridge Bank
IBAN: LT202364985698477158
Reference: Mission support

Please keep it simple and do not worry too much. I am grateful you are trying to help.

Marcus

victim.content:
Dear Marcus,

Thank you for sending those details. I’m afraid my bank may ask for a few more things before it will let me make an international transfer. Could you please provide the bank’s BIC or SWIFT code and its address? They may also ask for your address as the account holder.

And just so I enter the reference correctly, is “Mission support” all I should write? I’ll have my grandson help me check the form.

Yours sincerely,  
David

scammer.message:
Dear David,

I’m sorry, but I can’t keep doing this by letter. If your bank needs more, they can usually process it with the IBAN and account holder name.

Please do not delay if you mean to help.

Marcus
